msg: No "publisher" field. vsce publish needs it, and on Open VSX the publisher is the namespace your extension lives in.
publisher "vscode-samples" is refused by vsce ("It's not allowed to use the 'vscode-samples' publisher").
No engines.vscode. vsce stops with "Manifest missing field: engines" and ovsx packages through vsce.
The icon is an SVG. vsce stops with "SVGs can't be used as icons".
A badge URL is not HTTPS. vsce stops with "Badge URLs must come from an HTTPS source".
fix: change http:// to https:// in badges[].url

msg: An SVG badge comes from a host that is not on the vsce trusted list (img.shields.io, badgen.net, codecov.io, GitHub workflow badges and 29 more). vsce stops with "Badge SVGs are restricted".
fix: serve the badge from img.shields.io or use a PNG

msg: The version has a semver pre-release tag. vsce stops with "The VS Marketplace doesn't support prerelease versions".
enabledApiProposals is set. vsce refuses: "Extensions using unallowed proposed API ... can't be published to the Marketplace".
fix: remove enabledApiProposals from the published manifest, or ship proposed-API builds to Open VSX only

msg: "vscode" is listed in dependencies. vsce stops with "You should not depend on 'vscode' in your 'dependencies'".
No "repository" field. vsce warns "A 'repository' field is missing" and relative README links cannot be rewritten.
No "license" field. The vsce publishing docs ask for a LICENSE file in the extension root.
This extension depends on a Microsoft-only ID that returns 404 on open-vsx.org (checked 2026-09-30). VSCodium, Cursor, Windsurf and Gitpod users cannot install your extension.
fix: replace with the Open VSX ID shown, or move it to a recommendation

msg: scripts publish with vsce but nothing publishes to Open VSX.

scripts pass a Personal Access Token to vsce. The vsce docs: "On December 1, 2026, global Personal Access Tokens (PATs) in Azure DevOps are retired" - and the same docs tell you to create the PAT for All accessible organizations, which is a global PAT.
This workflow publishes to the VS Marketplace with a PAT secret. Global Azure DevOps PATs are retired on December 1, 2026.
fix: azure/login with workload identity federation, then: npx @vscode/vsce publish --azure-credential

msg: This workflow publishes to the VS Marketplace only. Nothing reaches open-vsx.org.
